limitations: One facing operation, one capsule outside profile and disjoint through holes in explicit card order, same coordinate system and stock.
25 original retained-face probes, 11 sections and 9 full incoming-height rays per hole are finite samples, not continuous GD&T.
Good final geometry alone does not establish card order or correct tool use; these have separate NC and material-prefix checks.
Two grid cells are a numerical guard, not certified uncertainty.
No nonzero WCS/TLO, roughness, fixtures, holder or material physics.
Facing checks the retained top/thickness; the separate profile checks the outside contour. No fixture retention or panel separation model.
